dedupe_keys.name: building permit information for alberta s census subdivisions 2015

description: Ten related source packages describe Alberta building permits, construction intentions and dwelling demolitions. Customised Building Permits Survey tables cover census subdivisions for 2015, census divisions/provincial totals for 2011–2012, and permits/values/demolitions for 2012–2013. Other components provide seasonally adjusted residential/non-residential intention values and municipal permit numbers/values by building type. A demolition-only XLSX component distinguishes single, mobile, cottage, double, row and apartment dwellings for 2012–2013. Further packages give monthly provincial/subdivision measures from 1992 through July 2014, monthly 2016 information and provincial monthly residential/non-residential values for 2007–April 2016. The 2016 native dates cover June–July and do not establish full-year coverage. The broad value series starts in 1977 without a stated end. These are construction intentions and demolition observations, not proof of completed construction. The source identifies capital-expenditure, net-capital-stock/depreciation and construction-investment estimation as uses. Different periods, geographies and adjustments remain separate within this curator-grouped family. Formats include XLS/XLSX, CSV, JSON, XML and PDF. One descriptor has an XLSX name and XLS format label; internal encoding is unverified. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves original Alberta identities and descriptive metadata. The licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs, current file access, numerical contents and full temporal continuity are unverified. No workbook, document or data body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond the source-described estimation roles remain unstated.
